title: MathShow Profile Save Remediation (AUD-02 F1-F3)
acceptance: R1: AUD-02 F1: the save transform preserves unknown stored fields; a profile that is newer than this build when saved is never rewritten (write refused, session memory-only). Specs cover migrate -> sanitize -> merge and a newer version appearing after load.

R2: AUD-02 F2: glyphsLifetime is credited additively (stored total + this session's unsaved increments), never max-merged; a two-session interleaving spec totals 16; repeated UpdateAsync callbacks cannot double-credit. No schema, key or lock change.
R3: AUD-02 F3: the final-source behaviour is evidenced, or jg confirms the recorded exception; API access state reported.
R4: AUD-02 is recorded in the repo (tracked) and linked from TASK-0138; check.sh and validators green; PR open, CI green, not merged; independent re-audit recorded.
notes: Started on jg's chat instruction 2026-11-05: "reaudit and make sure its passing if not fix it up until it passes. make sure there are no more untracked files". Fixes the two high findings of AUD-20261103-TASK-0138-02 (Codex, FAIL, post-merge on 1d4eaff). NO schema change: glyphsLifetime already exists; if exactly-once needs an operation-id field, STOP and ask jg (DataStore schema change needs fresh approval). Out of scope: other profile fields, key renames, data wipes, live experience, publishing, merging, saving MathShow.rbxl.
